## fresh-gui {{VERSION}}

Native desktop app for project files, terminals, and Git, with a local or SSH-connected daemon.

### Recommended install

Windows x86_64 (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirhosseindavoody/fresh-gui/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

Linux x86_64:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirhosseindavoody/fresh-gui/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

The installers download the latest release. Open a new terminal, then run `fresh-gui` or `fresh-gui user@host`.

### Manual downloads

- Windows client: `fresh-gui-client-{{VERSION}}-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip`
- Linux client: `fresh-gui-client-{{VERSION}}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`

Daemon archives are for servers and advanced setups. See the [README](https://github.com/amirhosseindavoody/fresh-gui#readme) for everyday use.
